name: Claire Higgins
psychographics: Values practicality above all; believes a penny saved is a penny earned toward family holidays.
current_solutions: Uses VoucherCodes, browser extension Honey, and shops at Aldi/Lidl for 70% of weekly groceries.
frustration: Logged into Tesco Clubcard at 11:30pm to find the 'members price' had expired 20 minutes ago, forcing her to pay full price for nappies.
decision_style: Reads reviews for weeks, then buys the cheapest option that has 4+ stars, often choosing own-brand over premium.
voice: Blunt and direct; often starts sentences with 'Look,' and will happily tell a cashier an item is overpriced.
